name: io.github.sachinbkale27/label-image-mcp
title: Histopathology Annotation MCP
description: Image annotation, incl. histopathology: nuclei, outlines, QC → QuPath/COCO/YOLO. No GPU.

environmentVariables.name: LABEL_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Image Label account username; leave unset to work as a guest (images kept 7 days, no whole slides)

environmentVariables.name: LABEL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Image Label account password (only with LABEL_USERNAME)
